hypothesis: At least one of three economically distinct factor gates can improve frozen V11 CAGR while timing risk-budget completion better than an ungated ALWAYS-FILL control, without exceeding 12% MDD or violating portfolio constraints.
allowed_changes: F-CURVE exact T10Y3M positive-spread factor gate from the frozen design
F-USD exact DX-Y.NYB 20-observation weakening factor gate from the frozen design
F-SIZE exact Russell 2000 / Russell 1000 20-common-observation relative-strength factor gate from the frozen design
forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any factor threshold, lookback, percentile, moving-average, stale-tolerance or sign-rule search
any rebalance-band search or overlay-semantic change
replacing a failed candidate after results are viewed
adding a fourth factor inside this trial
leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
using realized candidate metrics to change another candidate
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Compare all factor candidates against V11-CONTROL and the non-candidate ALWAYS-FILL control, then mechanically report ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and STRONG_INCREMENTAL flags.
pass_fail_gates: at least 4/7 fixed folds have candidate Sharpe >= ALWAYS-FILL Sharpe in the same fold
max gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
STRONG_INCREMENTAL only if admitted plus CAGR >= V11 CAGR +1.0 percentage point and Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe
follow_up_policy: No rescue grid or transform is allowed after results. Do not alter the 20-observation horizon, curve zero threshold, seven-calendar-day stale rule, factor sign, 25% band or fill-to-100% semantics. Any different factor or transform is a separately preregistered family, and all F-CURVE/F-USD/F-SIZE results remain in G3 trial accounting.
expected_outputs: all seven fixed fold metrics for both controls and every factor candidate
trade count and average cash ratio
target fingerprint, max gross and min target weight
mechanical ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and STRONG_INCREMENTAL flags for every factor candidate
run authorization receipt, exact execution Git commit and SHA-256 evidence manifests

F-USD.risk_on_rule: latest T-1 close <= close 20 source observations earlier

F-SIZE.risk_on_rule: latest T-1 (^RUT/^RUI) >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
